name: Satellaview
description: A Super Famicom add-on that downloaded games over satellite from broadcaster St.GIGA, sold in Japan from 1995. It delivered episodic and live-scheduled games, including new Zelda and Mario content, until broadcasts ended in 2000.

specs.memory: 512 KB RAM in add-on + 1 MB ROM; 8 Mbit memory packs
specs.media: Satellite broadcast, BS-X cartridge and 8 Mbit memory packs

curiosities: 'SoundLink' games streamed live voice acting from radio personalities and could only be played at their broadcast times.
Much of the broadcast-only content was never preserved and is considered lost.
Nintendo bought a 19.5% stake in St.GIGA in 1994 ahead of the service.
Active users peaked at about 116,000 in March 1997.
bestsellers: BS The Legend of Zelda: Third Quest
